en:
<CLT=cltMIND>After leaving the room, I could still hear the
muffled buzzing and Kokichi screaming.

We might be corpses by tomorrow
morning...

Don't joke about that...what if it happens?
It's just plain possible.

So how do we return these Kubs Pads back
to their rightful owners?

Hmmm, if only the Monokubs were here.
I'm sure they'd help us.
...Oh, it's just you?

THE-OTHERS-ARE-ASLEEP... IF-YOU-NEED-
SOMETHING, I-CAN-HELP YOU.

Ah, um...it's about the Kubs Pads...
Kokichi brought them to us, and...
I-SIMPLY-NEED-TO...RETURN-THEM.

I-WILL...RETURN-EACH-ONE-TO-YOUR-
RESPECTIVE-ROOMS...YOU-BASTARDS.

Ah...he left.
Well, that was abrupt.

But out of all of them, we can probably 
trust that one, right?

Shall we go back to our dorms? It is well
past nighttime.

Nyahahaha, that's true! We have the
magic show tomorrow.

Because of all this, we couldn't do a rehearsal,
but I'm sure it'll be a divine show.
We'll be waiting for you to come watch!

Hmph! "We'll be waiting," she says.
It's Himiko's show, not yours.
I suppose it's alright...

<CLT=cltMIND>I just remembered, I wasn't
able to train with Kaito today.

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, too bad. We can do it
tomorrow night, though.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's not like I'll never see
him again or anything.

<CLT=cltMIND>Worn out from all the commotion,
we dragged ourselves back to our rooms.
